resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR text and cherylhill.net give 1915; firelookout.com and an NHLR photo caption give 1917. Not resolved; the story reports both.

firelookout.com and cherylhill.net say 1932. NHLR says the steel tower was constructed in 1932 but also that it was not completed until 1933. Not resolved; the story reports the Register's own inconsistency.

A 1991 report (via cherylhill.net) says no longer full-time, staffed in high fire danger. The Roaming Civic says abandoned since the 1940s. cherylhill.net's 2024 visit says not staffed in any capacity. Not resolved; the story reports the differences and does not give a single end date.

NHLR says the cabin was restored in 2005 and both structures are intact and maintained; the 2024 visitor found the cabin worse for wear with nothing done since 1998. Not resolved; the story reports the 2024 observation.
NHLR 7,050 ft (2,149 m); firelookout.com and the Roaming Civic 7,078 ft; cherylhill.net 7,083 ft. The brief uses the NHLR figure. Elevation is not in the story.

notes_for_editor: Four sources. Brief's build year 1932 and the NHLR 1996 registration check out; the brief's height (10.7 m) matches the 35-foot tower. Build dates for the stone cabin (1915 vs 1917) and the steel tower (1932 vs 1933 within NHLR) conflict. Staffing end is unresolved across the 1991 report, the Roaming Civic 1940s claim, and the 2024 visit. The Forest Lookouts page for Walker (oregonlookouts.weebly.com) was not read past the county index, so its August 13, 1932 entry is unverified. The Roaming Civic also mentions a garage added in 1934 and a 1996 restoration program; those lines appeared only in search snippets, so they are not cited. The 1942 and 1967 cherylhill.net photo captions have no text, so they are not used. The abandonment date (since the 1940s) is not recorded as an event because no exact year is given.
